periods.time: Fourth day of Yamagata joint training camp
periods.summary: After Ikki has defeated all professional coaches provided by Kyoumon, Kikyo and Botan Hagure ask him for a two-on-one mock battle. Ikki defeats them without swinging Intetsu by redirecting Kikyo's spear charge into Botan, then explains their tactical problems while Shizuku heals Botan's scrape.
periods.cause: The Hagure sisters want practical guidance from Hagun's strongest representative after seeing his training-camp dominance.
periods.outcome: Ikki's reputation as a teacher and overwhelming combat reader is reinforced; the sisters' limitations are clarified before the Akatsuki crisis.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki's standing among Hagun representatives and introduces the Hagure sisters' combat styles before their later evacuation role.
